answer: Resist sybils by pricing identity in capital. Each agent posts a refundable bond into a sable collateral registry; influence equals its bond over the median bond. The registry is the anchor: one key, one bond, one vote, and a fresh key sits at weight zero until its bond matures. A puppeteer funding N puppets posts N full bonds, losing the discount an honest agent enjoys, and each detected duplicate burns its bond, so attack cost grows linearly. The cipher is stake provenance: bonds trace to distinct funding events, so one wallet backing two identities voids both.
